chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Islam is built upon five: upon the Salat, and the Zakat, and the Sawm, and the Hajj, and the Wilayah. And nothing was called out to like what was called out to regarding the Wilayah. So the people took the four and neglected this, meaning the Wilayah.
ai.seo_question: What are the five pillars of Islam according to Shia hadith, and what is the significance of Wilayah?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi presents a foundational Shia doctrine by elevating Wilayah to the status of a fifth pillar, distinctively emphasizing its divine proclamation compared to the ritual acts. Scholars note that while the four physical pillars were universally accepted, the spiritual and political authority of the Ahl al-Bayt was often neglected, highlighting a critical gap in comprehensive Islamic practice. This inclusion underscores that true submission requires both ritual observance and allegiance to the divinely appointed guardians.
